title: Hackers behind $6.3bn Binance heist ‘used malware and bogus job interviews’
summary: Firm reveals details about how its cryptocurrency exchange was compromised, saying operation began in June The hackers behind the $6.3bn (£4.7bn) Binance heist used bogus job interviews, malicious software and an internal AI tool, the company has revealed. The world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange was compromised in an operation that began with an inadvertent download of malware in June, led to a recruitment scam in September and then a raid last week of “hot wallets” where billions of dollars worth of crypto-assets were taken. Continue reading...
title_en: Hackers behind $6.3bn Binance heist used malware and fake job interviews
title_zh: 币安63亿美元窃案黑客使用恶意软件和虚假面试
summary_en: Binance revealed hackers behind the $6.3bn heist used fake job interviews, malware and an internal AI tool. The operation began with a June malware download, escalated via a September recruitment scam, and ended in last week's raid on hot wallets.
summary_zh: 币安披露63亿美元窃案细节：黑客利用虚假面试、恶意软件及内部AI工具，从6月恶意软件下载开始，经9月招聘骗局升级，最终上周盗取热钱包资产。

title: AI ‘godfather’ Geoffrey Hinton says it might turn out humans would have been better off without AI
summary: Nobel winner who devised concept of neural network warns AI could be near to triggering major incident such as power or banking shutdown One of the “godfathers of AI”, Geoffrey Hinton, has said it could turn out that humans would have been better off never developing the technology as he warned it could trigger a large-scale incident this year or next such as a temporary blackout of financial or power systems. The Nobel prize-winning computer scientist told the Guardian he is not a “doomer” about the technology that is underpinned by his groundbreaking research into artificial neural networks and believes AI has the potential to lead to a “wonderful future” but he said “it might be that we would have been better off never developing it”. Continue reading...
title_en: AI 'Godfather' Geoffrey Hinton Says Humans Might Have Been Better Off Without AI
title_zh: AI“教父”辛顿称人类或许本不该发展AI
summary_en: Nobel laureate Geoffrey Hinton warns AI could trigger a major incident within a year or two, such as a financial or power system blackout, and says humans might have been better off never developing it.
summary_zh: 诺贝尔奖得主辛顿警告，AI可能在一两年内引发金融或电力系统瘫痪等重大事故，并称人类或许本不该发展这项技术。

title: AMD stock jumps 7% on earnings as data center revenue nearly doubles
summary: AMD reported better-than-expected third-quarter results, driven by booming sales of AI chips
title_en: AMD Stock Jumps 7% on Earnings as Data Center Revenue Nearly Doubles
title_zh: AMD财报亮眼 数据中心营收近翻倍 股价大涨7%
summary_en: AMD reported better-than-expected third-quarter results, driven by booming AI chip sales, with data center revenue nearly doubling and shares rising 7%.
summary_zh: AMD第三季度业绩超预期，AI芯片销售强劲推动数据中心营收近乎翻倍，股价上涨7%。

title: Google says there’s no way to use Search without using artificial intelligence
summary: In announcement geared to schools, tech giant shows how entwined AI is with the world’s most popular website Google just acknowledged that you can’t use Google Search without using artificial intelligence . The search giant announced a slate of new AI products for classrooms and schools on Tuesday as well as more ways for teachers and schools to limit or restrict use of those AI tools. The company said the schools should have control over whether students use AI in the classroom. There’s one catch, though: if a school or teacher blocks the use of Google’s AI features, students won’t be able to use Google Search. Continue reading...
title_en: Google says there's no way to use Search without using artificial intelligence
title_zh: 谷歌称使用搜索功能无法避开人工智能
summary_en: Google acknowledged that using Google Search now inherently involves AI, as it announced new classroom AI tools and controls. Schools that block Google's AI features will also block students from using Google Search entirely.
summary_zh: 谷歌承认使用谷歌搜索必然涉及人工智能，同时宣布面向学校的新AI工具及管控措施。若学校禁用谷歌AI功能，学生将无法使用谷歌搜索。

title: AI-generated 'slopaganda' in political ads puts internet platforms on alert
summary: Tuesday's midterm elections follow record spending on AI-generated political ads.
title_en: AI-generated 'slopaganda' in political ads puts internet platforms on alert
title_zh: AI生成的“垃圾宣传”政治广告引发互联网平台警惕
summary_en: Record spending on AI-generated political ads ahead of Tuesday's midterm elections has platforms on alert over 'slopaganda'—low-quality, mass-produced AI content—raising concerns about misinformation and ad oversight.
summary_zh: 中期选举前AI生成政治广告支出创纪录，平台警惕“垃圾宣传”式低质AI内容泛滥，引发对虚假信息与广告监管的担忧。

title: Apple starts giving Siri AI access to third-party apps
summary: Apple will now let Siri AI perform actions across third-party apps. As part of the iOS 27.3 update rolling out on Tuesday, Apple announced developers can now integrate Siri AI's new features in "all apps," allowing the voice assistant to draw on a user's personal context, process natural language prompts, and use on-screen awareness to […]
title_en: Apple lets Siri AI act across third-party apps in iOS 27.3
title_zh: 苹果iOS 27.3允许Siri AI跨第三方应用操作
summary_en: With iOS 27.3, Apple now lets developers integrate Siri AI in all apps, enabling the assistant to use personal context, natural language prompts, and on-screen awareness to perform actions across third-party apps.
summary_zh: 苹果随iOS 27.3更新宣布，开发者可在所有应用中集成Siri AI，使其能利用个人上下文、自然语言指令和屏幕感知，在第三方应用内执行操作。

title: AI inference startup Fal doubles its valuation to $16B as demand surges
summary: The five-year-old startup raised a $1.3 billion round led by Bessemer.
title_en: AI inference startup Fal doubles valuation to $16B as demand surges
title_zh: AI推理初创公司Fal估值翻倍至160亿美元，需求激增
summary_en: Fal, a five-year-old AI inference startup, raised $1.3 billion led by Bessemer, doubling its valuation to $16 billion amid surging demand for inference infrastructure.
summary_zh: 成立五年的AI推理初创公司Fal完成13亿美元融资，由Bessemer领投，估值翻倍至160亿美元，反映推理基础设施需求激增。

title: Meta seeks to raise up to $25 billion in debt sale as AI spending jumps
summary: Meta is aiming to raise between $20 billion and $25 billion in a bond sale as the company ramps up spending on infrastructure and AI models and services.
title_en: Meta Seeks to Raise Up to $25 Billion in Debt Sale as AI Spending Jumps
title_zh: Meta拟发债融资至多250亿美元，AI支出激增
summary_en: Meta aims to raise $20-25 billion through a bond sale to fund infrastructure and AI model and service expansion as its AI spending surges.
summary_zh: Meta计划通过债券发行筹集200亿至250亿美元，用于加大基础设施及AI模型与服务投入，AI支出持续攀升。

title: Binance co-CEO Richard Teng says hackers used fake job interviews, AI tool to steal $6.3 billion in crypto
summary: Binance has replenished 98% of $6.34 billion in affected assets, according to a security report the crypto exchange issued Tuesday.
title_en: Binance Co-CEO Richard Teng Says Hackers Used Fake Job Interviews and AI Tool to Steal $6.3 Billion in Crypto
title_zh: 币安联席CEO邓伟政称黑客利用虚假面试和AI工具窃取63亿美元加密货币
summary_en: Binance says hackers used fake job interviews and an AI tool to steal $6.34 billion in crypto. The exchange has replenished 98% of affected assets, per its Tuesday security report.
summary_zh: 币安称黑客利用虚假面试和AI工具窃取63.4亿美元加密货币，根据周二发布的安全报告，该交易所已补足98%的受影响资产。

title: OpenAI says ChatGPT is catching up to Google in search
summary: In many circles, "Ask Chat" has replaced "Google it," and that's reflected in a new announcement from OpenAI: the volume of search queries run through ChatGPT now equals 20 percent of the volume run through Google. Adam Fry, OpenAI's consumer product lead for ChatGPT, made the announcement at a press event on Monday. He said […]
title_en: OpenAI says ChatGPT search volume hits 20% of Google's
summary_en: OpenAI's Adam Fry said ChatGPT now handles search query volume equal to 20 percent of Google's, citing growing consumer adoption of 'Ask Chat' over traditional search.
summary_zh: OpenAI消费产品负责人亚当·弗莱表示，ChatGPT的搜索查询量已达到谷歌的20%，反映消费者日益倾向用ChatGPT替代传统搜索。

title: Cold war? Why are fridges being hacked and what could be next? - The Latest
summary: Supermarket fridges and freezers in several European countries have malfunctioned after a reported cyber-attack, with their thermostats remotely cranked up. It is unclear who is behind the latest apparent attack but the EU has condemned what it said was ‘a deliberate attempt to disrupt our food supply’. It comes as the UK’s cybersecurity body warns AI-powered malicious software is ‘highly likely’ to be used in hacking attacks against the UK’s power stations, airports and hospitals by 2028. Lucy Hough speaks to global tech reporter Aisha Down – watch on YouTube Continue reading...
title_en: European Supermarket Fridges Hacked in Cyber-Attack on Food Supply
title_zh: 欧洲超市冰箱遭网络攻击，食品供应受威胁
summary_en: Supermarket fridges and freezers across several European countries malfunctioned after a cyber-attack remotely raised their thermostats. The EU condemned the 'deliberate attempt to disrupt our food supply,' while the UK warns AI-powered malware could target critical infrastructure by 2028.
summary_zh: 欧洲多国超市冰箱和冰柜遭网络攻击，温控器被远程调高导致故障。欧盟谴责这是“蓄意破坏食品供应”，英国警告到2028年AI恶意软件极可能攻击关键基础设施。

title: Ted Schlein’s Ballistic Ventures seeks $490M for new funds amid AI-driven cybersecurity boom
summary: Cybersecurity focused Ballistic Ventures is seeking to raise $360 million for a new flagship fund and another $130 million for a separate investment vehicle.
title_en: Ballistic Ventures Seeks $490M for New Funds Amid AI Cybersecurity Boom
title_zh: Ballistic Ventures 借AI网络安全热潮寻求4.9亿美元新基金
summary_en: Cybersecurity-focused Ballistic Ventures is raising $360 million for a new flagship fund and $130 million for a separate vehicle, capitalizing on the AI-driven cybersecurity boom.
summary_zh: 专注网络安全的Ballistic Ventures正筹集3.6亿美元旗舰基金和1.3亿美元独立基金，以把握AI驱动的网络安全热潮。

title: Hiding inside Palantir’s skyrocketing quarter is a foreboding signal
summary: Palantir delivered such a huge third-quarter earnings report on Monday that its press release even bragged that the numbers were “crushing consensus expectations.” Yet, retail investors were lukewarm on the company on Tuesday, with the stock trading slightly down. That’s because Palantir’s enterprise sales, its big growth area, showed signs of slowing. First, the good […]
title_en: Palantir's Blowout Quarter Hides a Warning Sign in Enterprise Sales
title_zh: Palantir财报亮眼背后暗藏企业销售放缓隐忧
summary_en: Palantir's Q3 earnings crushed consensus expectations, yet its stock dipped as enterprise sales, its key growth driver, showed signs of slowing, raising concerns about future momentum.
summary_zh: Palantir第三季度财报远超市场预期，但股价小幅下跌，因其关键增长引擎企业销售显露放缓迹象，引发市场对未来增长动能的担忧。

title: CrowdStrike launches AI kill switch that it says can stop internal agents that go rogue
summary: CrowdStrike launched an AI kill switch that the company says can stop internal agents, block relaunches and cut enterprise network access.
title_en: CrowdStrike launches AI kill switch to stop rogue internal agents
title_zh: CrowdStrike推出AI紧急制动开关，可阻止内部失控智能体
summary_en: CrowdStrike unveiled an AI kill switch that it says can halt internal AI agents, block relaunches and cut enterprise network access, targeting risks from rogue agents inside corporate environments.
summary_zh: CrowdStrike发布AI紧急制动开关，称可中止内部AI智能体、阻止其重启并切断企业网络访问，以应对企业内部失控智能体带来的风险。

title: Apple warns of risks related to AI agents behaving in 'unintended or unpredictable' ways
summary: Apple’s annual filing warns that AI agents could exceed permissions, resist instructions or take actions that are difficult to reverse.
title_en: Apple Warns AI Agents May Act in Unintended or Unpredictable Ways
title_zh: 苹果警告AI智能体可能以意外或不可预测的方式行事
summary_en: Apple's annual filing warns that AI agents could exceed permissions, resist instructions, or take actions that are difficult to reverse, flagging new risks for the company.
summary_zh: 苹果在年度文件中警告，AI智能体可能超越权限、抗拒指令或采取难以逆转的行动，提示公司面临新的风险。

title: Jim Cramer likes CrowdStrike's new 'AI kill switch' and the cyber stock
summary: Jim Cramer sees the tool as a significant growth driver for CrowdStrike and a breakthrough for the broader industry.
title_en: Jim Cramer Likes CrowdStrike's New 'AI Kill Switch' and the Cyber Stock
title_zh: 吉姆·克莱默看好CrowdStrike新推出的“AI终止开关”及该网络安全股
summary_en: Jim Cramer sees CrowdStrike's new 'AI kill switch' as a significant growth driver for the company and a breakthrough for the broader cybersecurity industry.
summary_zh: 吉姆·克莱默认为CrowdStrike新推出的“AI终止开关”将成为公司重要增长动力，也是整个网络安全行业的突破。

title: Netflix’s new AI Discover tab helps you find something to watch based on your mood
summary: The first experimental feature under the tab will allow users to get recommendations based on what they're currently in the mood for.
title_en: Netflix's new AI Discover tab helps you find something to watch based on your mood
title_zh: Netflix推出AI发现标签页，根据心情推荐内容
summary_en: Netflix launched an experimental AI Discover tab that recommends shows based on users' current mood, marking the first feature under this new tab.
summary_zh: Netflix推出实验性AI发现标签页，可根据用户当前心情推荐影视内容，这是该标签页下的首个功能。

title: Apple’s latest watchOS beta includes its new always-on Audio Intelligence features
summary: Starting today, Siri can tune into the Apple Watch's mic with Audio Intelligence features that are available in the new watchOS 27.3 developer beta rolling out now. The two new additions are Siri Recap, which uses "ambient listening" to generate summaries of your conversation, and Live Rewind, which generates text transcripts of the last 15 […]
title_en: Apple's watchOS 27.3 Beta Adds Always-On Audio Intelligence Features
title_zh: 苹果watchOS 27.3测试版新增常开音频智能功能
summary_en: Apple's watchOS 27.3 developer beta introduces Audio Intelligence, letting Siri use the Watch mic for Siri Recap, which summarizes conversations via ambient listening, and Live Rewind, which transcribes the last 15 minutes of audio.
summary_zh: 苹果watchOS 27.3开发者测试版推出音频智能功能，Siri可通过手表麦克风实现对话摘要和最近15分钟音频转录。

title: Indie games are missing launch dates because Steam is backed up
summary: Many indie game developers have recently posted on social media about unexpectedly long approval wait times for their game submissions on Steam, with some of the approvals causing developers to miss their planned launch dates. For example, Studio Daimon, the team behind an upcoming title called Food Devils, had planned to launch the game in […]
title_en: Indie Games Miss Launch Dates as Steam Approval Backlog Grows
title_zh: Steam审核积压致独立游戏错过发售日
summary_en: Indie developers report unexpectedly long Steam approval wait times, forcing some to miss planned launch dates. Studio Daimon's Food Devils is among the affected titles as the submission backlog grows.
summary_zh: 多名独立开发者反映Steam游戏审核等待时间异常漫长，部分作品因此错过原定发售日，Studio Daimon的《Food Devils》亦受影响，提交积压问题日益严重。
